records.name: Sabina
records.facts_used: The Lithuanian dictionary lists Sabina with the equivalent Sabine and Sabinas with Latin Sabinus. This Roman name family refers to the Sabines, an ancient people of central Italy. It is an ethnic name formation, not a claim that a modern bearer belongs to that ancient people. Both exact forms appear as personal names in the Senn–Salys dictionary of 1968, reprinted in 1983. The same page also records Sabas as a short form of Sabinas. These are dated linguistic records of names and their relationships, not the first use of the family in Lithuania.
